snippet.title: Qualia - Official Teaser Trailer | Dames 4 Games Halloween Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Check out the Qualia teaser trailer for this upcoming retro-inspired interactive fiction text game where you analyze and categorize two participants based on their responses to a series of questions. Are they really human? Are you? Qualia will be available on PC.
